q: Our Puebla plant supplies a German carmaker. What will their carbon request look like?
title: Puebla auto supplier carbon request
short: Expect a request for Scope 1 and 2 by plant, a footprint for each part number, the share of renewable electricity and a reduction plan. Data often goes through the carmaker's own supplier portal, so keep the figures and their sources in one place.
audience: Automotive suppliers in Puebla and Tlaxcala serving German carmakers

ul: Plant Scope 1 and 2 with method and factors.
Product footprints, often cradle to gate.

p: Collect a year of electricity bills, fuel invoices and production by part number. Material emissions need supplier data or defaults.
Use the same period and factors across every buyer portal, so the numbers match when compared.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
